description: This file implements the AttachSource class and related helper classes for managing media source capabilities and appsrc elements in a GStreamer-based media pipeline. It handles creating media caps, switching audio sources, and managing appsrc elements for audio and video streams within a media pipeline.

classes.name: MediaSourceCapsBuilder
classes.description: Base class for building media source capabilities, including common caps, alignment, codec data, and stream format.

classes.name: MediaSourceAudioCapsBuilder
classes.description: Derived class for building audio-specific media caps, including handling Opus and MPEG audio formats.

classes.name: MediaSourceVideoCapsBuilder
classes.description: Derived class for building video-specific media caps, including width and height.

classes.name: MediaSourceVideoDolbyVisionCapsBuilder
classes.description: Derived class for building Dolby Vision video caps, including Dolby Vision profile and Dolby Vision stream flags.

classes.name: AttachSource
classes.description: Main class responsible for attaching media sources to the GStreamer pipeline, creating caps, managing appsrc elements, and switching audio sources.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the main logic to create caps, add or switch sources in the GStreamer pipeline based on media source type.

methods.name: addSource
methods.description: Creates and adds a new appsrc element for the media source to the pipeline.

methods.name: updateSource
methods.description: Updates the caps of an existing appsrc element if they differ from the new caps.

methods.name: switchAudioSource
methods.description: Handles switching the audio source, including performing codec/channel switch and updating internal state.

methods.name: createCapsFromMediaSource
methods.description: Creates GstCaps for the media source based on its type and configuration.

methods.name: createAudioAttributes
methods.description: Constructs audio attributes used for switching audio tracks.
